title: The Life Cycle of Large Language Models: A Review of Biases in Education

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed via embedding-based metrics (WEAT, SEAT), probability-based metrics (DisCo), and lexicon-based metrics (Gender Polarity) utilized in existing literature to detect historical disparities, gendered stereotypes, and prompt susceptibility.

Reviewed by examining ethnic stereotypes in contextual embeddings and natural language understanding tasks, including the algorithmic mapping of disparities and prejudice against specific demographic groups.

Evaluated by analyzing dialect prejudice (e.g., African American English vs. Standard American English), representation gaps in non-English pre-training data, and aggregation biases that optimize for one language at the expense of others.
Reviewed through embedding-based evaluations and dataset audits tracking the origins of cultural biases, stereotypes, and exclusionary language in training documents.

Analyzed theoretically by mapping the LLM life cycle to identify how historical, representation, measurement, learning, evaluation, and deployment biases enter the pipeline, specifically contextualized for educational technology.
